title: Pumpkin Purchase
statementMd:
You are in charge of buying a pumpkin to carve into a jack-o'-lantern for your suite's Halloween decorations! After performing extensive research at the nearby supermarket, you've realized that the supermarket generally charges more for larger pumpkins, but the relationship is complicated: you've fit a cubic curve relating price $p$ of the pumpkin to its volume:

$$V(p) = a_0 p^3 + a_1 p^2 + a_2 p + a_3$$

for some positive constants $a_i$ you've calculated from the data.

A good-looking jack-o'-lantern must be carved from a pumpkin of volume at least $V_T$. Given $V_T$, what's the cheapest price you'll have to pay to acquire a sufficiently-large pumpkin?

## Input

The only line of input contains five space-separated real numbers $V_T$, $a_0$, $a_1$, $a_2$, and $a_3$. These numbers might be expressed in scientific notation (see sample inputs) and are all in the range $\left[ 10^{-9}, 10^9\right]$.

## Output

Print the smallest value of $p$ for which $V(p) \geq V_T$. Your answer will be judged correct if it differs from the judge's solution by absolute or relative error at most $10^{-6}$.

## Note

Hint: in order to satisfy the above error bound, be sure to print many digits of $p$ (at least 8).

For example, if your answer is stored in `ans`:

- Java: System.out.printf("%.10f%n", ans);
- C++: cout << fixed << setprecision(10) << ans << '\n'; (include `<iomanip>`)
- Python: print(f"{ans:.10f}")
statementZhMd:
你负责购买一个南瓜，将它雕刻成南瓜灯，用来装饰你们的套间，迎接万圣节！在附近的超市进行了充分调查后，你发现超市通常会对较大的南瓜收取更高的价格，但两者之间的关系比较复杂：你拟合出了一条三次曲线，描述南瓜的价格 p𝑝 与其体积之间的关系：

V(p)=a0p3+a1p2+a2p+a3

𝑉(𝑝)=𝑎0𝑝3+𝑎1𝑝2+𝑎2𝑝+𝑎3

其中，ai 是你根据数据计算得到的正数常量。

要雕刻出一个好看的南瓜灯，南瓜的体积必须至少为 VT。给定 VT，购买一个足够大的南瓜最少需要花多少钱？

## 输入格式

输入仅一行，包含五个以空格分隔的实数 VT, a0, a1, a2, and a3。这些数可能使用科学计数法表示（见样例输入），且均在 [10−9,109] 范围内。

## 输出格式

输出满足 V(p)≥VT 的最小 p 值。如果你的答案与标准答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 10−6，则视为正确。

## 说明

提示：为了满足上述误差要求，请确保输出 p 的足够多位数字（至少 8 位）。

例如，如果你的答案存储在 `ans` 中：

- Java：System.out.printf("%.10f%n", ans);
- C++：cout << fixed << setprecision(10) << ans << '\n';（需包含 `<iomanip>`）
- Python：print(f"{ans:.10f}")
